1028.description: A dip with machine assistance that lets you build triceps strength while handling less of your bodyweight.
instructions: Set the assistance and stand on the pad holding the handles.
Keep your elbows close and your chest up.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until they are at 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders and move smoothly.

1156.description: Lying or planking with the feet in the straps, you swing the legs side to side like a pendulum to train the obliques.
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Swing your legs together to one side.
Swing back through the center to the other side.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Keep your shoulders stable.

1220.description: A calf raise done on a chest press style lever machine, using the seat and handles to load the calves.
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the balls of your feet on the lower platform or press plate.
Push to straighten your legs and release the safety.
Lower your heels as far as is comfortable.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause at the top and lower under control.

1284.description: Lying across a stability ball, you arc one dumbbell back over your head and return it. It stretches and works the chest and lats.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball and roll forward until your upper back is resting on the ball.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head while keeping your arms straight.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，向前滚动，直到上背部靠在球上。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，同时保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1348.description: A machine row with an underhand grip and a vertical handle path. It works the upper back, lats and biceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate position to ensure proper alignment.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度和踏板位置以确保正确对齐。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在踏板上。
反手握住手柄，手掌朝上。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1412.description: Sit with your forearms on a bench, palms up, and curl a barbell with your wrists. It strengthens the front of the forearms and grip.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Rest your forearms on the bench, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Keeping your forearms stationary, exhale and curl your wrists upwards as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
将前臂放在长凳上，让手腕悬在长凳边缘。
保持前臂静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲手腕。
保持收缩位置短暂停顿，然后吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1476.description: A squat on a single leg that challenges strength and balance. It targets the glutes and quads on one side at a time.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one leg forward, keeping it off the ground.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
向前伸出一条腿，使其离开地面。
弯曲站立的腿并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
推动脚后跟返回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。

1540.description: A squat that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains legs and shoulders together in one fluid rep.
instructions: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly forward and feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lock out the press with the bar over your mid-foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Keep your core braced the whole time and avoid arching your lower back.

1604.description: A flowing lunge with a twist and reach that opens the hips, hamstrings and upper back. A favorite warm-up move.
instructions: Start in a lunge position with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Place your hands on the ground on either side of your right foot.
Lower your left knee to the ground and extend your right leg, keeping your right foot flat on the ground.
Rotate your torso to the right, reaching your right arm up towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
Switch sides and repeat the stretch with your left foot forward.
instructionsZh: 从弓步位置开始，右脚向前，左脚向后。
将双手放在右脚两侧的地面上。
将左膝降低到地面并伸展右腿，保持右脚平放在地面上。
向右旋转你的躯干，将你的右臂伸向天花板。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后回到起始位置。
换边并重复拉伸，左脚向前。

1668.description: A one-arm seated dumbbell curl on an exercise ball. It trains the biceps and your balance.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing up and your arm fully extended.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1732.description: A forward lunge combined with a triceps extension. It trains the triceps and legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Keep your back straight and your chest up.
Extend your arms straight overhead, keeping your elbows close to your ears.
Lower the dumbbells behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then straighten your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将手臂伸直过头顶，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂回到起始位置。
重复该动作达到所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

1796.description: Reaching one arm up and rotating your trunk stretches the lats and the muscles around your spine. It also gives your mid back some rotation.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and reach one arm overhead.
Rotate your upper body gently away from the raised arm and reach up and over.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1860.description: Back extension on a bench that strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lift your torso until it forms a straight line with your legs.
Do not overarch at the top, then lower with control.

1924.description: Standing with the toes lifted against a surface to stretch the calf.
instructions: Stand facing a wall or step and place the ball of one foot against it with the heel on the floor.
Keep the leg straight.
Lean your hips gently toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your heel down and your back tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1988.description: A kneeling stretch where you reach one arm across the body to open the back of the shoulder.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and slide one arm across the floor in front of you, palm down.
Sink your chest toward the floor and keep reaching until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2116.description: Rolls the knees to one side while lying on your back to twist the lower spine and loosen the hips and sides.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Slowly lower both knees to one side.
Turn your head the other way if it feels comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Bring the knees back to centre and roll to the other side.

2308.description: A kick that swings in an arc to hit with the shin or instep, powered by a hip turn.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Pivot on your supporting foot and turn the hip over.
Lift the knee and swing the leg in an arc across the target.
Extend the lower leg at the end.
Pull the leg back and return to stance.
Repeat, then switch legs.

2500.description: A chest-supported rear fly on an incline bench that isolates the rear shoulders.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest on the pad.

2564.description: A plank with jumping jack feet on a medicine ball, challenging core stability.
instructions: Place your hands on a medicine ball in a plank.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the planned reps.

2756.description: A cable leg raise to the side with the toes turned in, shifting the work toward the outer glute.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes inward slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

2948.description: Rolling the chest on a foam roller. It can loosen tight pecs before pressing or after desk work.
instructions: Lie face down and place the roller under one side of your chest.
Extend that arm out to the side.
Roll slowly side to side and up and down.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.

3012.description: A scapular dip, moving the shoulder blades while your arms stay straight. Strengthens the traps and shoulder stabilisers.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows and retracting your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to squeeze a pencil between them.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to extend your elbows and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂在身前伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
弯曲肘部并缩回肩胛骨来降低身体，就像你试图在它们之间挤一支铅笔一样。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力，伸展肘部，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3204.description: A full sit-up with the arms stretched overhead, which makes the lever longer and the move harder. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms overhead, keeping them straight.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is upright.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂伸过头顶，保持伸直。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲直到躯干直立。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3268.description: Lower your legs to the side from a raised position to hit the lower abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and legs raised straight up.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower both legs toward one side, stopping just above the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.

3332.description: A crunch over a stability ball while holding a weight, using the ball for a longer range of motion in your abs.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Let your torso drape back over the ball for a full stretch.
Curl up until your upper back clears the ball.
Lower slowly back into the stretch and repeat.

3396.description: A gentle hip stretch that moves through flexion and extension to loosen the hips and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Extend the leg again and press it down to the floor.
Repeat on the other leg.
Breathe slowly and stay relaxed.

3460.description: A side plank with the top leg lifting inward, working the inner thighs and obliques.
instructions: Set up in a side plank with the bottom knee bent.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your hips.
Raise the bottom leg toward the top leg.
Lower with control.
Switch sides.

3524.description: A squat combined with a Pallof press. It builds leg strength with anti-rotation core work.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on, holding it at your chest.
Squat down, keeping your torso tall.
Stand and press the band straight out in front.
Resist the band trying to rotate you.
Bring your hands back to your chest.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3588.description: Swing your arms quickly while standing to warm up the shoulders and raise your heart rate.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and knees soft.
Swing both arms across your chest and open wide.
Keep your torso upright and relaxed.
Increase speed gradually.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

3652.description: A Romanian deadlift in a staggered stance using a trap bar for hamstring and glute strength.
instructions: Stand inside a trap bar with one foot slightly behind.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Lower the bar along your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish reps, then switch the stance.

3716.description: A split squat paired with a backward roll to challenge your control and leg strength.
instructions: Start in a split stance with your torso upright.
Lower into a split squat until the front thigh is parallel.
Sit back and roll onto your back with control.
Roll up and return to the split stance.
Stand and repeat, then switch legs.

3780.description: A standing press against band tension. It builds your chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold the handles at your chest.
Stand in a staggered stance with your core braced.
Press both hands forward until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to your chest.
Keep your shoulders down and your back still.

3908.description: A standing side bend and twist that loosens the hips and trains the obliques.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width and one arm overhead.
Turn your feet slightly outward.
Hinge at the hips and rotate your torso toward the floor.
Reach your free hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with control.
Switch sides after your reps.

3972.description: Press dumbbells overhead one arm at a time. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell overhead until the arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.
Press with the other arm.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

4036.description: Leg curl with a tube band around the ankle, building the hamstrings.
instructions: Attach the band to a low anchor and loop the handle around one ankle.
Face the anchor and hold a support for balance.
Curl your heel toward your glute.
Keep your knees close and your hips steady.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4100.description: A hack squat on a sled with a wide foot position, stressing the quads, glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Set your back on the pad and place your feet wide and slightly turned out on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the platform.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking out.
Keep your hips and back against the pad.

4164.description: A full body move: burpee onto dumbbells, then swing them overhead. It builds power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Squat and place the dumbbells on the floor, then step or jump your feet back.
Do a push up if you like.
Jump your feet forward and stand up, swinging the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells under control.
Keep your back flat and move with rhythm.

4228.description: From a half kneeling stance you press one handle forward and pull another back at the same time. It challenges core stability and coordination.
instructions: Kneel on one knee between two cable stations, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep your torso tall and your core braced.
Press one handle forward while pulling the other toward your ribs.
Return to the start under control.
Do not let your torso twist.
Switch your kneeling leg after a set.

4292.description: Lying face down, you curl a dumbbell held between your feet toward your glutes. A simple way to train the back of the thighs without a machine.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench and grip the edge for support.
Have a dumbbell gripped between your feet, or placed by a partner, with legs straight.
Bend your knees and curl the weight toward your glutes.
Pause briefly at the top without lifting your hips.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.

4356.description: An anti-rotation press where you push a cable straight out and resist the twist. Great for core stability.
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable set at chest height, hands holding the handle at your chest.
Step away to load the cable and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without rotating.
Bring it back to your chest, then switch sides.

4420.description: A low-impact cardio move where you march in place to raise your heart rate and warm up the legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your steps.
Keep a steady pace for 1-3 minutes.

4484.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the upper chest below the collarbone. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your upper chest below the collarbone while leaning on a wall or lying face down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4548.description: A burpee with a squat finish that raises your heart rate and works the whole body.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest down, then press back up.
Jump your feet forward to your hands.
Stand and finish with a bodyweight squat before the next rep.

4612.description: A standing arm circle against a wall that mobilises the shoulders while keeping your back from compensating.
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet slightly forward.
Start with arms straight down at your sides, palms forward.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and overhead in a wide arc, staying close to the wall.
Lower them back down the same way.
Keep your ribs and head against the wall.

4740.description: A hang power clean followed by an overhead jerk. It is a full-body power move for hips, legs and shoulders.
instructions: Hold dumbbells hanging just above your knees with a flat back.
Explode up and pull the weights to your shoulders, catching in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then dip slightly with your knees.
Drive up and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then to the hang, and reset.

4804.description: A barbell triceps press where the bar travels lower, closer to your face or chest. It hits the triceps hard through the bottom of the movement.
instructions: Hold a barbell at arm's length over your chest, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your elbows tucked.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Pause briefly when the bar is low.
Extend your arms to return the bar to the start.

4932.description: A lying hip mobility move where you draw a figure eight with the bent knee. It loosens the hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift one knee above the hip.
Trace a slow figure eight in the air with your knee.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Keep your pelvis steady on the floor.
Switch legs after a set.

5060.description: Lying face down, you gently lift your head. It trains the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead on the floor or a towel.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Slowly lift your head a few inches, keeping your chin tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

5124.description: Jump while twisting your hips and legs to the side. It warms up the core and legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms bent.
Jump and twist your hips and legs to one side while your shoulders face forward.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-45 seconds.

5188.description: A power clean flowing straight into a front squat and overhead press. It is a big full-body power movement.
instructions: Set up with the barbell over mid-foot and grip it just outside your knees.
Pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand, then sink into a full front squat.
Drive up and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and then to the floor with control.

5316.description: A bent-over row on the smith machine using a narrow overhand grip. Hits the lats and mid back.
instructions: Set the bar at knee height and grip it with hands close together, palms down.
Hinge forward with a flat back and unlock the bar.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly.
Keep your hips back and torso still.

5380.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shoulder and upper back. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your upper back.
Place the roller under the shoulder and upper back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Rotate your top arm back and forth to open the shoulder.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5636.description: Kneeling one-arm landmine press for shoulder strength with an angled path.
instructions: Kneel holding the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your set.

5700.description: Walk forward staying high on your toes with every step. It builds calf endurance and ankle control without any equipment.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Take a step forward, staying on your toes.
Keep alternating steps without dropping your heels.
Lower your heels when you reach the end of the set.

5892.description: A low lunge with both hands inside the front foot. Opens the hips and groin.
instructions: Start in a low lunge with your back knee down or lifted.
Walk your front foot to the outer edge of your mat.
Place both hands inside the front foot.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.

6148.description: A seated overhead extension done one arm after the other. It isolates the triceps through a deep stretch.
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand overhead.
Lower one dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend the arm back up.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your core braced.

6788.description: A simple check of how far the hip turns inward. You do it gently to see your range.
instructions: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg outward so the hip rotates inward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.

7108.description: A machine leg extension that isolates the front of the thigh. It builds quad size and strength.
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and shins behind the roller.
Align your knees with the machine pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower with control.

7556.description: Jumping jack variation that stays in a squat for a leg-burning cardio move.
instructions: Start in a squat with hands at your chest.
Jump your feet out wide.
Hop back to the narrow squat stance.
Stay low the whole time.
Land softly and keep your chest up.

7620.description: A bench press with bands attached to the bar, so resistance rises toward lockout. It builds pressing power across the chest and triceps.
instructions: Set bands on the bar and lie on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Unrack the bar over your chest with a firm grip.
Lower it to your mid chest under control.
Press up and out until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet down.

8900.description: A second variation of the cable punch, built for quick power in the pushing muscles. Your trunk works to stay stable.
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable and hold the handle at chest height.
Step into a staggered stance and brace your core.
Punch forward fast and rotate your torso slightly.
Stop short of locking out your elbow.
Pull the hand back under control.
Repeat, then switch arms.

9604.description: A box step-down drill that builds knee strength and control in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright.
Lightly tap the floor.
Press up through your working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9988.description: A kneeling sissy squat with a resistance band for assistance or load. It places a big stretch on the quads.
instructions: Set the band at a stable anchor and kneel with it around your body or hands.
Keep your hips forward and your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lean back slowly, keeping your hips extended.
Go as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself back up.
Keep your core braced and your movement smooth.

10052.description: A side-to-side deep squat holding a landmine end at your chest. It works the glutes, inner thighs and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet wide, holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee deeply.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Push through the bent leg to return to centre.
Shift to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and heel down on the working side.

10116.description: A close grip press on an incline bench using the guided Smith bar to hit the triceps and upper chest.
instructions: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back with eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly narrower than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest with elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pulled back.

10564.description: Seated, you roll the foot inward and outward. It mobilizes the ankle and foot.
instructions: Sit on a chair with one foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Roll the sole of your foot inward.
Roll it outward as far as is comfortable.
Keep the lower leg still.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

10756.description: Small forward hops driven by the calves. They build ankle stiffness and reactive power.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Push off the balls of your feet and hop forward a short distance.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Hop back or turn around and repeat.
Stay light and quick through the whole set.

10820.description: A standing hip abduction on one leg with a band. The bent working knee changes the angle.
instructions: Place a band around your ankles or knees.
Balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Bend the other knee and lift it out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

10948.description: A scapular pull-up with a gentle swing. It builds shoulder blade control and grip.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulder blades down without bending your elbows.
Swing your body forward and back in a small arc.
Keep the motion controlled.
Lower to a full hang and repeat.

11268.description: A squat holding a cable at the chest. The cable adds load and encourages an upright torso.
instructions: Hold a cable handle at your chest and stand with feet shoulder width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

11652.description: A seated nerve glide that alternates straightening the leg and moving the head to ease the back of the leg and improve mobility.
instructions: Sit tall at the edge of a chair with your hands on the seat or resting in your lap.
Slowly straighten one knee while you lower your chin toward your chest.
Bend the knee back down while you lift your head and look up.
Keep the motion smooth and gentle, never forcing into a strong stretch or tingling.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps, then switch legs.

11716.description: A strongman-style overhead press with a heavy stone, using a small leg drive for power.
instructions: Lift the stone to your chest, hugging it close.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your core.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Press the stone overhead to full lockout.
Lower it back to your chest with control.

0068.description: A single-leg squat with the bar on your back. Challenges the quads, glutes and balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell across your upper back.
Lift one foot off the ground and extend it forward, keeping it parallel to the ground.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair, keeping your chest up and your back straight.
Lower yourself until your thigh is parallel to the ground, then push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
将一只脚抬离地面并向前伸展，保持与地面平行。
弯曲站立的腿，放低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低身体直到大腿与地面平行，然后通过脚后跟推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

0196.description: A hip hinge facing away from a low pulley with a rope between the legs. You drive the hips forward to strengthen the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grab the rope attachment with both hands and step forward, creating tension in the cable.
Bend at the hips and lower your upper body until it is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to pull your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 背对缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
双手抓住绳索附件并向前迈一步，在绳索中产生张力。
弯曲臀部并降低上身直至与地面平行，保持背部挺直。
启动臀肌和腿筋，将身体拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0260.description: A floor ab move where you curl the upper body up while lying on your back. It targets the abs with controlled crunching.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0324.description: An incline dumbbell press with the palms facing in. It works the upper chest and the front shoulders.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Plant your feet firmly on the ground and keep your back straight against the bench.
Start with the dumbbells at shoulder level, elbows bent and palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells up and away from your body, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将双脚牢牢踩在地面上，并保持背部挺直靠在长凳上。
从与肩同高的哑铃开始，肘部弯曲，手掌相对。
将哑铃向上推离身体，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0388.description: Seated, you press dumbbells overhead one arm after the other. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell up overhead, fully extending your arm.
Lower the dumbbell back down to shoulder height.
Repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将哑铃举至肩部高度，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
将一只哑铃举过头顶，完全伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回至肩膀高度。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

0452.description: At a preacher bench, you curl an EZ bar with an overhand grip. It strengthens the forearms and upper arm flexors.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the ez barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your upper arms on the pad, allowing your forearms to hang down.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
反手抓住 ez 杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将上臂放在垫子上，让前臂下垂。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0580.description: A machine shrug without gripping a bar, so you lift your shoulders straight up. Focuses on the upper traps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
Grasp the handles with your palms facing inwards and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight, exhale and elevate your shoulders as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a brief moment, then inhale and slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在杠杆机上。
手掌朝内，抓住手柄，双臂完全伸展。
保持背部挺直，呼气并尽可能抬高肩膀。
保持收缩一会儿，然后吸气并慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0708.description: A crunch focusing on the sides of the waist. It strengthens the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and tilted to one side.
Place your hands behind your head.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulders.
Squeeze your side.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

0772.description: A standing overhead press with the smith bar lowered behind the head. It builds the shoulders and triceps and needs good shoulder mobility.
instructions: Adjust the seat height of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder level.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Position the bar behind your head, resting on your upper traps.
Keep your core engaged and your chest lifted throughout the exercise.
Press the bar overhead by extending your arms, fully straightening them.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整史密斯机的座椅高度，使杠铃与肩部齐平。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上抬起并向后退一步，保持稳定的姿势。
将杠铃放在脑后，放在斜方肌上部。
在整个练习过程中保持核心收紧并抬起胸部。
伸展双臂，完全伸直，将杠铃推过头顶。
在动作的最高点稍作停顿，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0836.description: A crunch where your legs extend as you curl up, holding a weight. It hits the abs and lower abs hard.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a weight at your chest.
Start with knees bent and lifted.
Curl up while straightening your legs forward.
Bring your knees back in as you lower.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.

0964.description: A lunge with arms raised overhead. It stretches the hip flexors and chest and strengthens the legs.
instructions: Step one foot back into a long stance, with the back foot turned out slightly.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Square your hips toward the front.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.
